desc: Phone (a 6.1 in iPhone sideways: the touch controls, with a Bluetooth controller as player 1's), co-op's player 2 on a second controller plays each of the seven partners in Rogueport: joins with its Start, then for Goombella, Koops, Bobbery, Yoshi, Flurrie, Vivian and Ms. Mowz in turn walks it, hops it and does its field move (X held, let go); every one back to standing or walking after (the playtest's partner stuck mid-jump: no STUCK)
